# JavaScript suite

## Source

69 source arguments from Acorn's own `tests-optional-catch-binding.js`, `tests-template-literal-revision.js`, `tests-import-meta.js`, `tests-import-attributes.js` and `tests-json-superset.js`. Original suite definitions are retained unchanged in `../standard/`. Each source string is preserved exactly; historical parser options are replaced by the documented ECMAScript 2025 contract. Invalid inputs are held to an explicit reference refusal and a runtime diagnostic.

## Version

Acorn 8.15.0, MIT license in `NOTICE-LICENSE`.
